rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with an expanded 3AA blastocyst, with appropriate comments on ICM, TE, blastocoel, and thinning zona; slightly overstates certainty from the image and adds minor details not clearly verifiable.
Integrates age, BMI, AMH, endometrium, male factor context, lifestyle, and cycle history with embryo quality well, though some links (e.g., stress and FSH implications) are somewhat overstated.
Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, and the implantation estimate follows from embryo quality plus maternal modifiers; minor issue in mixing implantation and live birth benchmarks.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice, especially support for single embryo transfer in a good-prognosis 34-year-old with a high-quality day-5 blastocyst; some statements about stress/alcohol effects are stronger than guideline-level evidence.
Provides practical next steps such as SET, medication adherence, and lifestyle advice, but future cycle planning is incomplete/truncated and lacks more specific contingency planning.
